metadata.description: A pure aggregation node. This component has no subpath entry points and no post-build step, so once the nested `npx nx run demo-firebase:build-base` shell-out became a dependsOn edge there was no command left to run -- hence `nx:noop` (a bare dependsOn with no executor is invalid; createTask throws). `outputs` is empty because build-base is the sole writer of dist/components/demo-firebase; declaring the directory here too would make a second task own it.

`^build`, not `^build-base`. @nx/js remaps @dereekb/* imports to the dist DIRECTORY, so TypeScript reads that directory's package.json `exports` -- and rollup writes `.` as {import, types} until that dependency's own `build` reorders it. This target previously had no dependsOn at all and got its ordering from the `build` wrapper (which inherits `^build` from the `build` targetDefault); now that `build` is a plain aggregation edge, the dependency edge has to live here.
